functions.name: midi_event_dispatch
functions.plate:
Executes one packed MIDI event from the ring (0 = ring empty, ignored).
Decodes r0=type*4, r2=ch, r3=port, r4=flags(ev>>27), r5=ch*0x48, r6=0xC400+port*0x480 (r5+r6 = MidiChannel) and jumps via the branch table at 0xA1C:
  0 note_off_ev 0xA3C, 1 note_on 0xAD8, 2 poly pressure 0x1368 (ret), 3 control change 0x185C, 4 program change 0x136C,
  5 channel pressure 0x13EC (ret), 6 pitch bend 0x13F0, 7 system 0x14B8 (ret).
Handlers get r1 = ev plus the precomputed registers above.

functions.name: note_off_ev
functions.signature: void note_off_ev(uint ev, uint ch, uint port)
functions.plate: Dispatch case 0 (note-off): note = (ev>>8)&0x7F, then falls through into note_off (0xA44).

functions.name: note_off
functions.signature: void note_off(uint note, uint ch, uint port)
functions.plate:
Releases every keyed voice (flags&0x80) playing port/ch/note (all matches, not just the first).
Clears VOICE_KEYON; if VOICE_HELD (0x40, damper at key-on) the channel keeps sounding.
Else age=0, keyon_delay=0 (cancel delayed key-on), level=0xFF and AICA key-off: ctl = (ctl & 0x7FF) | KYONEX.
Also reached from note_on for velocity 0 (r0 = note).

functions.name: note_on
functions.signature: void note_on(uint ev, uint ch, uint port, uint prio, uint ch_ofs, uint ch_base)
functions.plate:
Dispatch case 1. vel = ev&0x7F (0 -> note_off). Stores port/prio/ch/note/vel into image scratch 0x1210-0x1214.
For each of the 4 layers of the channel's program (MidiChannel+0x14 -> ToneProgram.layer[i], bank-relative, 0 = unused, layer.num_splits bit7 = muted):
  scan splits (0x30 bytes) for key_lo<=note<=key_hi && vel_lo<=vel<=vel_hi; on match voice_alloc (priority = ev>>27);
  alloc failure -> keep scanning (dead path: voice_alloc never returns 0xFF); success -> program the AICA channel and go to the next layer.
Channel programming (register images in the split, adjusted by MidiChannel offsets and PortState): key off, SA(bank-relative)+LSA/LEA,
AR/D1R/D2R (+ch 0x37/0x38/0x38 - quirk: D2R uses the D1R offset), DL/RR (+ch 0x39/0x3B), LFO depth scaled by mod wheel (ch+2),
DSP send (IMXL override ch+0x36, port+0x26 offset; ISEL ch+0x46), FLV0-4 (+ch 0x28.. -0x2000 + ch.cutoff 0x40, clamp 8..0x1FF8),
filter EG (ch 0x32-0x35), Q (+ch 0x27-0x40) and LPOFF (ch 0x3D), TL from velocity curve x ch level(0x0A) x (256-TL) + port volume,
pan (tone DIPAN or ch pan 0x0B) + port pan, DISDL + port 0x24, pitch (voice_set_pitch with port pitch + bend),
then flags |= KEYON (| HELD if ch+0x26 bit6), age=1, level=0, LFORE cleared, KYONEX|KYONB unless the layer has a key-on delay.
Quirk: split count loop is decrement-then-test, so count 0 would run 2^32 times.
Registers live across the body: r2 split, r5 MidiChannel, r6 voice, r8 AICA ch, r11 split count, r12 layer count (voice_alloc/voice_set_pitch preserve them).
Ghidra shows the voice_alloc status test as '(ly & 0xff) == 0' and ac as an input: the r0 status and r8 channel are extra voice_alloc outputs.

functions.name: voice_alloc
functions.plate:
Chooses a voice for note_on. Priority = note_prio (0x1211). Returns r6 = Voice*, r8 = AICA channel, r0 = 0 ok / 0xFF none.
Idle voice (u32 at +0 == 0) is taken at once; voices with prio > new prio are skipped. Best record at 0x135C {voice, aica, level, prio, age, port}.
best.level != 0: only flags==0 voices qualify, lower level wins, equal level -> v.prio >= best.prio wins.
best.level == 0: a flags==0 voice wins; otherwise v.prio <= best.prio and v.age >= best.age wins.
Ghidra signature shows only the r6 result; r8 (AICA channel) and r0 (status) are also outputs.
BUG: r1 is left at 0x1368 after clearing the record and only reset to 0x135C when a voice passes the priority test; if all 48 voices are busy with higher priority, r6/r8 are loaded from 0x1368/0x136C (instruction words 0xE1A0F00E/0xE0855006) and r0 = 0 (success) -> note_on programs a bogus voice.
Hence r0 = 0xFF is unreachable: if any voice passes the prio test the first one is always recorded as best.

functions.name: voice_set_pitch
functions.signature: void voice_set_pitch(Voice * v, ToneSplit * sp, uint pitch, AicaChannel * ac)
functions.plate:
pitch (1/256 semitone, wrapping) += split fine (s8 @+0x27).
idx = ((pitch>>8) + note + 0x60 - root) & 0xFF -> pitch_oct_tbl (0x3564): OCT in bits7:4, semitone in 3:0.
fidx = semitone*128 + (pitch&0xFE)/2 -> pitch_fns_tbl (0x3648) low 8 bits, +0x100 for each of fidx>=0x1EF/0x383/0x4D9.
Writes AICA pitch (OCT<<11 | FNS) only if changed. Used by note_on, pitch bend (0x13F0) and voice_update_4ms.

functions.name: voice_update_4ms
voices_key_off_all
functions.plate:
Clears VOICE_KEYON of all 48 voices and keys every channel off (ctl & 0x7FF | KYONEX).
Ignores VOICE_HELD, leaves level/age/keyon_delay (pending delayed key-on still fires). No direct callers.

functions.name: voices_key_off_port
functions.plate: voices_key_off_all restricted to voices with v.port == port (r0). Called from the sequencer (0x7664).

functions.name: fx_prg_select
functions.plate:
Validates SFPB program prg (bank 0x14200, 0 -> built-in 0x2908 'e-reverb') and queues it for the main-loop loader (0x61D4).
Called from cc_dsp_program (0x24EC, port 7 only) with value-1; host cmd 0x84 enters 1 insn earlier at 0x5C94 (r0 = cmd[2]).
Errors OR-ed into drv_err (0x13420, byte) and returned as drv_err|err (full word): 2 bad magic 'SFPB', 8 version!=1, 4 no 'ENDB' at size-4, 0x10 prg>=count(+0xC, unsigned),
1 no FX work ring (0x14288 == 0 or < 0x18000), else ring size (0x1428C) < need[RBL] (unless entry[0x23]&0x30) -> see BUG.
(SH-4 SDD_DRV_ERR_* are these bits << 3: 0x08 not downloaded, 0x10 id, 0x20 end id, 0x40 version, 0x80 number.)
fx_prg_sel(0x5DC8)=prg is written before the SFPW checks. Success: fx_rb_pending(0x13010) = RBP|(RBL&3)<<13, fx_prg_pending(0x1300C) = entry, fx_load_req(0x13014) = 1; returns 0.
Size/address checks are cmp+bmi (N flag of the difference). RBL not range-checked (need table has 4 entries).
BUG: when the SFPW ring is too small (0x5D58) r1 still holds rb_size*4, so 0/4/8/0xC (none / illegal end / illegal version / both) is ORed instead of 1.

labels.name: note_prio
labels.comment: note_on scratch: event flags ev>>27 = voice priority

labels.name: note_q_lpoff
labels.comment: Q | LPOFF for the TL_Q write

comments.text: VOICE_HELD: damper was down at key-on -> keep sounding
r6 = voice, r8 = AICA channel, r0 = 0 ok / 0xFF
r0 = voice_alloc status (0 ok; 0xFF never happens, see voice_alloc BUG)
no voice: try the next split
ch+3 bit7: RPN bend range overrides the layer's
quirk: D2R also uses ch+0x38 (D1R offset)
ch+0x3D LPOFF override: 0 = tone, bit6 = filter on
upper clamp only tests bits 15:13 of v+8
ch.pan bit7 set -> use tone pan
voice prio higher than ours: never steal
BUG: r1 still 0x1368 if no voice passed the prio test -> reads code words as voice/AICA ptr
0xFF = no voice (unreachable: r6 is never 0 here)
age counts only while keyed or held
FLV0/1 clamp negatives to 8, FLV2-4 to 0; the next test makes both 8
BUG: error exit with r1 = rb_size*4 instead of 1 (N-flag test, not signed <)
r1 = rb_size*4: table index AND later the RBL/"error" value
returned r0 = drv_err | err (full word); only the low byte is stored
